## GrudgeBlox Test World

Production sandbox for **voxel / GRUDOX-style** lobby + character select (Notblox `/play/test` flow) with **fleet Railway heroes** and **weapon skill combat timing**.

### Stack
- Lobby: name + fleet roster (Mine-Loader multi-era pattern)
- Avatar: assets.grudge-studio.com grudge6 race kits
- Skills: windup → active hit / projectile impact
- DNS: blox.grudge-studio.com · mine.grudge-studio.com · grudox.grudge-studio.com

### Controls
- WASD move · Space jump · E interact · 1–5 skills · Mouse look
